svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.15.3.5 Adjustments to Footing Widths for Exterior Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.15 FOOTINGS AND FOUNDATIONS
Adjustments to Footing Widths for Exterior Walls

g.text: INCREASE TO THE TABLE 9.15.3.4. WIDTH, EXTERIOR WALLS, SENTENCE (1)
For each storey supported by the
flat insulating concrete form wall construction
Table 9.15.3.4. strip footing widths for exterior walls: 250 mm (9 13/16″) for 1 floor, 350 mm (13¾″) for 2 floors,
Where a foundation rests on gravel, sand or silt with the water table less than the footing width below the
bearing surface, the width required by this Article is doubled (Clause 9.15.3.4.(3)(a)).

svg.text: The strip footing widths for exterior walls in
Table 9.15.3.4. are increased for each storey
(a) 65 mm (2 9/16″) for each storey of masonry
(5⅛″) for each storey of masonry construction,
and (c) 150 mm (5⅞″) for each storey of flat
Drawn: 2 storeys of each kind on the 350 mm table width, added width split each side. Wall and unit sizes are illustration only.
